Info

Defines structural runtime-checkable protocol IFrameTransformer for work coordinate transformations.

class scaralang.core.service.transformation.iframe_transformer.IFrameTransformer(*args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Bases: Protocol

Structural protocol defining contract for work coordinate frame transformations.

It defines:

methods:
transform_point - Transforms local frame coordinates into global base coordinates.
get_version - Returns the transformer version string.

Transforms point from local work frame to global base coordinate system.

Parameters:

  • frame – WorkFrame instance defining offset and rotation.

  • point – Local coordinate Point2D in millimeters.

Returns:

Transformed global coordinate Point2D.
